summary: Iteration 31 QA — Trusted MFA devices, printable child-codes sheet, public pages regression. Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration31.py: 4/4 passed (director login → mfa_required → verify with remember:true sets mfa_trust httpOnly cookie; GET /api/auth/mfa/devices returns >=1 device with current:true; a fresh login carrying only mfa_trust cookie returns user directly with landing=/admin and no mfa_required; DELETE /api/auth/mfa/devices/{id} requires X-CSRF-Token (missing header → 401/403; correct header → 200 ok; re-login after forget → mfa_required again; deleting the same id twice → 404). Cleanup revokes all created trust devices (active_devices=0 verified in Mongo). Regression: /app/backend/tests/test_auth_v2.py + test_iteration28.py = 19/19 pass. NOTE: /app/backend/tests/conftest.py monkey-patches requests.Session.request to auto-complete MFA and inject X-Client: api, which prevents observing the mfa_required challenge; iteration31 tests therefore use httpx.Client directly to bypass the patch — kept as-is per instructions. Frontend Playwright (chromium 1440x900): (1) Director /login?area=staff → email/password → mfa-remember is checked by default → TOTP → land /admin. (2) /sicurezza renders trusted-devices-card with 1 device showing 'questo dispositivo' badge; click trusted-device-forget-{id} shows toast 'Dispositivo dimenticato' and trusted-devices-empty visible. (3) /admin/t/{TID}/rose shows child-codes-link (href /admin/t/{tid}/rose/codici with ?club= param when a team is selected); /admin/t/{TID}/rose/codici renders child-codes-sheet with 26 club sections (>= required 18), 57 rows, 9-char link codes, print button, back link. With ?club=6a9b5b045d9e0985643d0ab2 only 1 club section (Sporting Eur) shown. child-codes-back returns to /admin/t/{TID}/rose. (4) Club manager societa@fsl.demo → /societa/rose → child-codes-link href=/societa/rose/codici → sheet with exactly 1 own-club section (Roma Nord), 19 rows, 9-char codes. (5) Public regression logged out: statistiche, classifiche, partite, squadre, top11, weekly, news, regolamento all render without 'Qualcosa è andato storto' error boundary and no ReferenceError/'slug is not defined' in console or pageerrors. Statistiche shows top scorers with 26 links to /tornei/la-serie-a-dei-bambini/giocatori/{id}. Logged-in fan (fan.notifiche@test.it): statistiche & classifiche verified — no error boundary/reference errors.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py forget_trusted_device: returns 404 when device_id has wrong length OR when update matched 0 rows — good. But `res = None if len != 24` then `res.modified_count` would crash — currently guarded by `not res`. Acceptable, but could raise 400 for malformed id for clarity.

auth.py _trusted_device sets last_used_at on every check but doesn't rate-limit — repeated invalid trust tokens still perform DB lookup on each login attempt. Not exploitable given brute-force lock elsewhere; noted.
Security.jsx renders very wide inline JSX for each device (single line li). Readability could improve by extracting a subcomponent — not a functional issue.

success_rate.frontend: 100% across trusted-devices, child-codes admin+club, public regression
